name: Necromancy
overview: Scripture clearly forbids necromancy and all forms of consulting with familiar spirits, warning God's people not to seek after wizards or witches, as seen in Leviticus 19:31 and 20:6-27. The Mosaic Law explicitly commands the Israelites to avoid the abominable practices of surrounding nations, including necromancy, divination, and enchantments (Deuteronomy 18:9-11). These prohibitions underscore God's holiness and His call for His people to trust Him alone rather than turning to occult practices.
